character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
top-down 2D pixel art game character sprite, single static idle pose facing directly toward camera (isaac-like top-down angle)
subject: young field alchemist, practical worn traveling coat (knee-length, functional not ornamental), leather harness with belt pouches and glass vial holders, fingerless gloves, sturdy boots — utilitarian adventurer silhouette, not a robed wizard
subtle etched alchemical circle motif on one glove or belt buckle as the only occult detail, no glowing effects, no visible weapon
color palette: muted earthy base tones only (worn brown leather, dark slate, faded olive) — deliberately no bright cloth colors, so alchemy/mixture effects remain the only vivid color in the game later
64x64 pixels, clean pixel grid, no anti-aliasing, 6-10 colors, flat lighting with soft directional shading
transparent background, centered, character fills ~70% of canvas height, small soft ground shadow beneath feet
no text, no UI, no watermark, no literal military uniform, no oversized weapon, no generic fantasy robe/pointy hat, no automail limb, no pocket watch
